_meta.indication: VOXZOGO is indicated to increase linear growth in pediatric patients with achondroplasia who are 5 years of age and older with open epiphyses; approved under accelerated approval based on improvement in annualized growth velocity.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: 52-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial; subjects randomized 1:1 to vosoritide 15 µg/kg or placebo, stratified by sex and Tanner stage.
pivotal_trials.population: Pediatric subjects ages 5 to <18 years with achondroplasia confirmed by genetic testing and open epiphyses.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary efficacy endpoint: change from baseline in annualized growth velocity (AGV, cm/year) at Week 52 (an intermediate clinical endpoint).
pivotal_trials.result: Vosoritide was superior to placebo for change in AGV at Week 52: LS mean difference 1.57 cm/year (95% CI: 1.22, 1.93; p<0.0001). Secondary height Z-score treatment difference 0.28 (95% CI: 0.17, 0.39; p<0.0001).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>10%) are injection site erythema, injection site swelling, vomiting, injection site urticaria, arthralgia, decreased blood pressure, and gastroenteritis. Decreased blood pressure occurred in 8 (13%) of 60 vosoritide subjects vs 3 (5%) of 61 placebo; injection site erythema 75% vs 69%; injection site swelling 62% vs 36%.
target_moa: Vosoritide is a modified recombinant human C-type natriuretic peptide (CNP) analog; binding to natriuretic peptide receptor-B (NPR-B) antagonizes FGFR3 downstream signaling via inhibition of ERK1/2 in the MAPK pathway, stimulating chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation to promote linear bone growth.
modality: peptide (modified recombinant human C-type natriuretic peptide analog)

boxed_warning.content: The prescribing information does not include a boxed warning; warnings and precautions are limited to the risk of transient decreases in blood pressure.

rems.type: The Applicant did not submit a REMS; FDA informed the Applicant that a REMS is not being considered for vosoritide.

advisory_committee.vote: A joint PAC and EMDAC advisory committee meeting was held July 30, 2018 to discuss therapeutic goals and clinical development; members agreed AGV can be used as a primary endpoint though final height is a key treatment goal. No approval vote reported.

description.text: Expanded patient population from pediatric patients 5 years and older to include all pediatric patients with achondroplasia with open epiphyses

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” sNDA provides for expansion of the patient population from pediatric patients who are 5 years of age and older to include all pediatric patients for the use of Voxzogo (vosoritide) for injection to increase linear growth in pediatric patients with achondroplasia with open epiphyses.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Improvement in annualized growth velocity (AGV), an intermediate clinical endpoint.

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on an improvement in annualized growth velocity [see *Clinical Studies (14)*].

Thus, based on these limitations, the submitted data support accelerated approval, but data on final height are needed to confirm that changes in the intermediate clinical endpoint of AGV ultimately translate into the intended clinical benefit of improved final adult height.

confirmatory_requirement.text: PMR 4134-1: an open-label, external-controlled trial in subjects with ACH 5 years and older with open epiphyses to measure the effect of vosoritide on final adult height (verify and describe clinical benefit).

citations.quote: 4134-1 Conduct an open-label, external-controlled trial in subjects with achondroplasia (ACH) 5 years of age and older with open epiphyses to measure the effect of vosoritide on final adult height. The trial should also evaluate disproportionality and bone age as secondary endpoints.

orphan_indication.text: Vosoritide received orphan designation for treatment of achondroplasia (granted January 17, 2013).

citations.quote: On January 17, 2013 vosoritide received orphan designation for treatment of ACH.

basis.text: Priority review granted January 25, 2021 based on the proposed indication (serious disease) and absence of alternative treatment.

citations.quote: Priority review status was granted for NDA 214938 on January 25, 2021, based on the proposed indication (serious disease) and absence of alternative treatment for the proposed indication.

summary.text: Vosoritide (VOXZOGO) received orphan drug designation for achondroplasia and priority review, and was granted accelerated approval based on the surrogate/intermediate endpoint of improvement in annualized growth velocity, with a required confirmatory trial to verify effect on final adult height.

citations.quote: On January 17, 2013 vosoritide received orphan designation for treatment of ACH.
Priority review status was granted for NDA 214938 on January 25, 2021, based on the proposed indication (serious disease) and absence of alternative treatment for the proposed indication.
This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on an improvement in annualized growth velocity [see *Clinical Studies (14)*].
